cases.title: First launch requires privacy consent and completes onboarding
steps: Install the app without existing container data
Launch and verify that browsing is blocked by the privacy screen
Verify Continue is disabled until the agreement switch is enabled
Accept and skip or complete onboarding
cases.expected: The native home appears only after consent and onboarding state is persisted.

cases.title: A newly added quick site is immediately visible and persists
steps: Open Add on the native home
Save OpenAI with openai.com
Verify OpenAI is the first visible quick site
Terminate and relaunch the app
cases.expected: The site remains first and visible after relaunch with the default six-site limit.

cases.title: Appearance and start-page controls are reachable and persistent
steps: Open Settings from the native home
Verify quick-site visibility, count, background, and manager controls
Select Dark appearance
Terminate and relaunch the app
cases.expected: The semantic dark appearance renders and the selection persists.

cases.title: Native home remains usable in landscape
steps: Rotate the simulator from portrait to landscape
Inspect the browser chrome and quick-site grid
cases.expected: Primary controls and visible quick sites remain on screen without clipping or overlap.

cases.title: Back, forward, and navigation-history selection stay synchronized
steps: Navigate from example.com to the IANA example-domains page
Go back and verify that Forward becomes enabled
Open Navigation History and select the forward entry
cases.expected: The history sheet exposes real WKWebView entries and selecting one navigates to the matching page.

cases.title: Pinned tabs and adjacent close selection persist
steps: Pin a normal tab from the tab overview
Create a second tab and close the active tab
Verify the adjacent pinned tab becomes active
Terminate and relaunch the app
cases.expected: The adjacent tab is selected and its pinned state survives relaunch.

cases.title: Soft tab limit offers cleanup without blocking creation
steps: Set the tab warning threshold to eight
Create tabs until the threshold is exceeded
Choose cleanup of old tabs
cases.expected: The alert offers Continue and Cleanup, and Cleanup reduces nine tabs to seven while keeping the active tab.

cases.title: Tab reordering stays within groups and persists
steps: Open the tab overview with multiple normal tabs
Use the accessible Move Backward action on the Example Domain tab
Verify that the card order changes without changing the active page
Terminate and relaunch the app
cases.expected: The reordered normal-tab sequence and active selection survive relaunch; pinned and private boundaries remain protected by policy tests.

cases.title: Supported Simulator keyboard commands and recent-closed recovery
steps: Press Command-T and verify that the tab count increases
Close the active tab from the overview
Press Command-Shift-T and verify that the page and recovery notice return
Open a web page, press Command-F, and verify that the find bar appears
cases.expected: New Tab, Reopen Closed Tab, and Find operate through the scene command routing. Host-reserved Command-L, Command-W, and Control-Tab are excluded from this Simulator result.

cases.title: Scroll position and safe form drafts resume after cold launch
steps: Open the local page-state fixture
Enter a restorable note and a password
Scroll to the final checkpoint and background the app
Terminate and relaunch the app
Verify the note returns, the password stays empty, and the resume prompt appears
Choose Continue and verify that Section 5 returns
Choose Start Over on a later launch and verify the persisted scroll position is cleared
cases.expected: Only the bounded non-sensitive draft is persisted; the user explicitly controls whether the fresh page returns to the saved position.

cases.title: Read-later and Library management persist across native surfaces
steps: Add the current local fixture to read later from the page menu
Open Bookmarks and verify that the same unified item carries a read-later marker
Open the native edit action, rename the item, and save
Open the renamed item and verify that its persisted isRead state becomes true
Open Settings and change history retention from 30 days to 24 hours
Verify HTML import/export actions and open the system exporter
cases.expected: Bookmarks and read-later share one durable item, management actions persist, retention is applied immediately, and transfer stays in bounded local HTML files.

cases.title: Download management survives pause, interruption, retry, and missing files
steps: Open the local resumable download fixture and start a 100 MB streamed download
Open Downloads, verify live byte progress, and pause the task
Resume the task and verify that it returns to downloading
Terminate and relaunch during the transfer, then verify interrupted recovery and retry
Open a completed file with Quick Look
Remove the completed fixture file outside the app and relaunch
Verify the record changes to a missing-file failure with a retry action
Open Settings and verify concurrency, large-file, Wi-Fi-only, and completion-notice controls
cases.expected: Download state is truthful and durable, every recoverable state exposes the correct action, policy settings persist, and missing files are never presented as openable.

cases.title: Offline article capture, organization, restore, search, and export
steps: Open the local long-article fixture and save it from the page menu
Open the offline library and search for a body-only keyword
Add tags, a topic, and a note
Scroll to the final checkpoint and terminate the app
Stop the fixture server, relaunch, and open the saved article
Verify the local image and restored reading position
Export the saved Markdown through the system share sheet
cases.expected: Captured content remains readable without its origin, organization metadata persists, full-text search finds body content, reading position restores, and a portable export is available.
cases.notes: Highlight persistence is covered by policy tests; text-selection interaction remains a physical-device acceptance item.

cases.title: Server-authoritative Pro gate and safe unavailable state
steps: Choose Save Offline Article while no verified entitlement exists
Verify that the Pro paywall opens instead of capturing the page
Inspect benefits, agreement, restore, manage-subscription, legal, privacy, and support controls
Enable the agreement switch while no App Store product is available in the Simulator
Open Settings and verify the Pro and support entries
cases.expected: Offline capture stays locked, live StoreKit pricing is never invented, purchase remains disabled without a valid catalog product, and both the feature gate and Settings reach the paywall.
cases.notes: The Simulator has no StoreKit account or available App Store products. The production gateway catalog was verified separately. Restore and purchase were not invoked; Sandbox/TestFlight transaction acceptance remains open.

cases.title: Site security state, insecure password warning, and selective clearing
steps: Open an HTTP fixture and inspect Website Security
Focus the fixture password field and verify the insecure-connection warning
Open example.com and verify the HTTPS security state
Open Privacy settings and toggle Clear Cookies When Closing Tabs
Open Clear Browsing Data and inspect all four selectable categories and history range
cases.expected: Connection state is truthful, HTTP password entry warns before input, privacy controls are reachable, and destructive clearing is never performed without the explicit Clear action.
cases.notes: The per-site and global destructive Clear actions were inspected but not invoked during this retained-data QA run. Certificate-error classification and website-data record matching are covered by focused tests.

cases.title: Web appearance, user-agent policy, and site zoom persist
steps: Open Example Domain and choose Web Display from the page menu
Verify one-shot Mobile and Desktop actions plus site and global user-agent controls
Set the Example Domain site policy to Desktop and page zoom to 125%
Open Settings and verify global webpage appearance and minimum-font-size controls
Set minimum font size to 18 pt, terminate the app, and relaunch
Reopen Web Display and verify the Desktop site policy and 125% zoom remain
cases.expected: The active page applies the zoom immediately, site and global controls remain reachable, and the site policy survives a cold launch.
cases.notes: The Simulator accessibility tree confirmed the persisted Desktop and 125% selections after relaunch. Policy normalization and legacy defaults are covered by focused tests.

cases.title: Harmony-matched six-rule site control surface
steps: Open Example Domain and choose Content Blocking from the page menu
Expand the current-site section and open Detailed Controls
Inspect every per-site policy picker
cases.expected: Network rules, tracker cleanup, element cleanup, automatic reader mode, dark web pages, and desktop website controls are all visible for the active host.
cases.notes: The retained Example Domain record remained on inherited values; persisted policy resolution and legacy four-rule decoding are covered by focused executable tests.

cases.title: Persistent product, legal, support, and filing information
steps: Open full Settings from the native home
Scroll to About and verify the current version summary
Open About and inspect the product message, legal links, support entry, and filing number
cases.expected: About remains available after onboarding and exposes the canonical product, version, legal, support, and filing information.

cases.title: Per-kind persisted site permission editing
steps: Open Settings with an existing site permission record
Inspect the separate camera, microphone, and location rows
Toggle one decision and verify unrelated decisions remain unchanged
cases.expected: Each persisted permission decision can be changed independently while whole-origin removal remains available.
cases.notes: The retained Simulator container had an empty site_permissions array. No new camera, microphone, or location request was triggered solely to manufacture QA state; policy behavior is covered by focused executable tests.

cases.title: Selection-aware omnibox editing shortcuts and completion
steps: Open a retained IANA tab and focus its populated address field
Verify the existing URL is selected; Clear, Cancel, current-host, .com, .cn, www., and path controls are visible
Replace the selection with openai and choose .com
Replace the text with openai again and choose the first suggestion completion action
Enter temporary text, choose Cancel, and verify the current page address returns
cases.expected: The focused chrome preserves editing space, shortcuts edit without navigating, first-result completion writes the full URL, and Cancel restores the active page address.
cases.notes: The accessibility tree exposed native Clear plus stable identifiers for Cancel and each shortcut. Focused Simulator tests passed 5/5 for selection edits, ordering, and idempotence.
